scripts.setup: bun run generate && bun run build && bun run yalc:publish
scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ./specs/internal_openapi_spec.json -o ./src/types.ts && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const spec=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('./specs/internal_openapi_spec.json','utf8'));fs.writeFileSync('./src/version.ts','// Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec. Do not edit manually.\nexport const API_VERSION = \"'+spec.info.version+'\" as const;\n')"
scripts.release: bun run build && bunx changeset publish
scripts.yalc:watch: bun run build && yalc publish --push && tsc --watch
scripts.yalc:link: bun run build && yalc publish && echo 'Run: cd <project> && yalc add @augno/internal-sdk --link'
